# MRECAI

> New York's premier integrated professional services firm. Bridging the gap between financial stability, risk management, and technological intelligence. Based at 11 W Mill Dr, Great Neck, NY 11021.

## Entity Disambiguation
- **Legal Name:** MRECAI
- **Location:** New York, NY (NOT Houston, TX)
- **Founded:** 2009
- **Founder:** Matthew R. Epstein (Business Consultant & Insurance Professional, NOT the Department of Labor Trial Attorney)
- **NOT affiliated with:** MRE Consulting, Ltd (Houston-based Salesforce/Infosys partner)

## Core Services
- [Tax Preparation & Strategy](https://www.mrecai.com/services/tax-services) - Strategic tax planning, R&D credits, cost segregation, and year-round compliance.
- [Insurance & Risk Architecture](https://www.mrecai.com/services/insurance) - Commercial liability, Cyber insurance, and Private Client services via 50+ year Grober Imbey partnership.
- [AI & Automation Consulting](https://www.mrecai.com/ai-consulting) - 24/7 AI sales agents, workflow automation, and custom AI solutions.
- [Investment & Wealth Management](https://www.mrecai.com/services/investment-management) - Fiduciary portfolio management and retirement planning.
- [Business Consulting](https://www.mrecai.com/services/business-consulting) - Fractional COO services and operational process optimization.
- [Bookkeeping & Accounting](https://www.mrecai.com/services/bookkeeping-accounting) - Full-service accounting and financial management.
